CSS-only lab

CSS as the layout powerhouse

This page uses MDL for structure and CSS for layout, theme, state, responsiveness, motion, and visual logic.

Theme

Density
:has + custom properties

State flows through CSS

Theme and density are radio inputs. CSS reads them with :has() and updates variables across the whole page.

@container

Cards answer their container

Resize the page and this grid changes from narrow cards to richer panels using container queries, not JavaScript.

color-mix + clamp

CSS can calculate design

Type, spacing, surfaces, and glow use clamp(), calc(), and color-mix() from the CSS bundle.

Native disclosure

What is CSS doing here?

It owns layout primitives, state styling, responsive rules, tokens, motion, and the final visual system. No JavaScript is needed for this interaction.

What does MDL do?

MDL gives predictable HTML hooks: .mdl-card, .mdl-grid, attributes like gap, and clean content. CSS turns those hooks into the experience.
